none: PAS ESS-08B879: A Roman silver radiate of Valerian I (AD 253-260).
contea di ritrovamento: Bedford (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver radiate of Valerian I (AD 253-260). Reece period 12. The coin is very worn, but the radiate bust is visible on the obverse with the inscription [VALER]IANVS AVG. The reverse depicts sol standing left, holding a whip and raising his right hand. The inscription would have read [ORIENS AVGG]. Mint unknown. Dimensions: diameter: 21.56 mm; weight: 2.72g
